# Test fixtures

- `bus.csv`: first 20 rows of a real PBH real-time bus snapshot (public data, 2026-10-13).
- `tomtom_route.json`, `here_flow.json`: **synthetic** payloads that follow the documented
  response structure of TomTom Routing v1 and HERE Traffic Flow v7. Values are made up and
  exist only to test parsers. Replace with real responses once API keys exist.
